description: This file defines a repository interface and its Firestore-backed implementation for managing 'TaskItem' objects in a Flutter application. It includes methods for streaming, fetching, creating/updating, and deleting tasks, utilizing Firestore collections and documents with converters and path helpers.

classes.name: ITaskRepository
classes.description: An abstract interface defining methods for task data management, including streaming, fetching, upserting, and deleting tasks.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: A Firestore-backed implementation of ITaskRepository that manages tasks using Firebase Firestore, including methods for real-time streaming, single fetch, creation/update, and deletion.

methods.name: streamTasks
methods.description: Streams a list of TaskItem objects for a user, ordered by 'updatedAt' in descending order.

methods.name: streamTask
methods.description: Streams a single TaskItem identified by its ID for a user.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a TaskItem once by its ID for a user.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a TaskItem in Firestore and returns its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by its ID for a user.
